item.title: Lab safety orientation
item.description: Required for everyone enrolled in the introductory chemistry lab before the first lab session. Attendance is checked at the door and a missed session must be made up before any lab credit is given.

item.title: Academic integrity workshop
item.description: A required session for everyone in the first-year seminar. The instructor will take attendance and the workshop counts toward the seminar's participation grade.

item.title: Advising appointment: incoming cohort
item.description: Every incoming student must meet individually with their assigned advisor before registration opens. Appointments that are missed must be rescheduled before the deadline.

item.title: Makeup exam session
item.description: For students approved to miss the scheduled midterm. Attendance is required for anyone on the approved list, and the room closes to new arrivals after the first thirty minutes.

item.title: First lab session, attendance required
item.description: The first meeting of the lab section. The syllabus states that missing this session without prior approval results in being dropped from the course.

item.title: Cohort orientation
item.description: A required half-day orientation for every student admitted to the fall cohort. Roll is taken at the start and the afternoon session is optional.

item.title: Spring career fair
item.description: Employers from a range of industries will be on hand with information about internships and entry-level openings. Open to students of every major; resumes are optional but encouraged.

item.title: Undergraduate research symposium info session
item.description: A chance to learn how to apply to present at the spring research symposium. Attendance is optional and open to any undergraduate curious about presenting their own work.

item.title: Hackathon kickoff night
item.description: Teams form on the spot and anyone from any major is welcome, no experience required. Pizza is provided and attendance is entirely optional.

item.title: Peer mentor info session
item.description: Learn what the peer mentor program involves and how to apply. Optional and open to any student who might be interested in mentoring next year's incoming class.

item.title: Guest lecture: renewable energy policy

item.title: Sesion informativa: creditos de transferencia
item.description: Esta sesion informativa es opcional y esta abierta a cualquier estudiante interesado en creditos de transferencia. No se tomara asistencia y no es obligatoria.

item.title: Faculty senate meeting
item.description: The monthly meeting of the faculty senate, covering curriculum and governance business.

item.title: Staff professional development day
item.description: A day of training sessions for staff, including a benefits update and a records-systems refresher.

item.title: Alumni homecoming reception
item.description: An evening reception for returning alumni during homecoming weekend, with remarks from the alumni association president.

item.title: Graduate student research colloquium
item.description: A colloquium where graduate students present dissertation progress to their department.

item.title: PhD candidacy exam schedule review
item.description: A planning meeting for doctoral candidates to review upcoming candidacy exam dates with their program coordinator.

item.title: New faculty orientation
item.description: An orientation morning for faculty who joined this semester, covering benefits, systems access and committee assignments.

item.title: Office hours
item.description: Weekly office hours held every Monday in the same room for the rest of the semester; no appointment needed.

item.title: Ceramics gallery exhibit
item.description: A standing exhibit of student ceramics work, on display in the gallery through the end of the month during normal building hours.

item.title: Writing center walk-in tutoring
item.description: Drop-in tutoring, no appointment needed, held every weekday for the rest of the semester in the same room.

item.title: Language exchange drop-in hour
item.description: A weekly recurring drop-in hour for informal conversation practice; come whenever you like, no sign-up and no set group.

item.title: Art museum permanent collection
item.description: The museum's permanent collection, open during regular museum hours for the whole academic year.

item.title: Department meeting
item.description: The department will hold its regular meeting at the time above.

item.title: Program requirement review
item.description: A review of requirements for the program will be covered at this time.
